description: This file defines theme-related resources for an Android app built with Jetpack Compose. It includes data classes for color tokens with light and dark variants, functions to get these color schemes, composable properties for accessing specific colors, gradient brushes, font styles, and typography tokens used throughout the app's UI.

methods.name: lightMobileColors
methods.description: Returns a MobileColors object with color values suitable for light theme.

methods.name: darkMobileColors
methods.description: Returns a MobileColors object with color values suitable for dark theme.
